sentences.text: Mira, an 8-year-old spayed Domestic Shorthair, refused every z/d feeding from Jun 5 to 19, 30 in a row (34 of 38 rated feedings refused), and her owner-entered Hill's z/d trial was stopped on day 19 of 42.

Intake not directly observed, as a free-fed Purina ONE bowl was down, and her weight is −6.8% in 18 days, 4.4 to 4.1 kg on 2 home-scale readings rounded to 0.1 kg, so the true loss lies between 4.6% and 9.0%.
In cats, 48 to 72 hours of markedly reduced intake is a hepatic-lipidosis risk window, and her total intake was not observed.
Vomiting is recorded on 5 of 19 logged days, and nothing is recorded after Jun 19, 13 days before this report.
